subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's shared repair that promotes known `antml:`/`mm:` attribute-dialect XML from degraded assistant text into executable tool calls while adding an opt-in Plugin SDK code-region preservation option?
rationale: Automation can verify parser coverage and obvious regressions, but the permanent boundary for model-emitted tool-call-shaped text and the additive SDK contract need maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Shared Repair
options.body: Land this branch after normal maintainer review because the shared repair/sanitizer layer is the most complete owner-boundary fix for the reported leak.

options.title: Require Strip-Only Scope
options.body: Ask for a narrower patch that hides namespaced XML from visible text but does not promote degraded XML into executable tool calls.

options.title: Pause For Consolidation
options.body: Hold this branch until maintainers decide how it should compose with broader plain-text tool-call repair work such as the adjacent suffix-preservation PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Repair
recommendation.body: Land this branch after normal maintainer review because the shared repair/sanitizer layer is the most complete owner-boundary fix for the reported leak.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent work on truncated tool-call execution and terminal scrubbing makes steipete the strongest available owner for this execution-boundary decision.
